## Advisor angle
If rates are expected to rise rather than fall, advisors may need to revisit client conversations about bond holdings, variable-rate debt and cash yields. CNBC is already framing what a December hike means for household spending. [CNBC](https://news.google.?oc=5)

## Term of the day: PCE inflation
The Personal Consumption Expenditures price index measures how much prices paid by consumers change over time. The Fed watches it closely, so a rising reading makes rate hikes more likely.

## Interview talking point
"With the Fed's preferred inflation gauge rising and major banks like J.P. Morgan forecasting hikes, I'm curious how advisors are repositioning client bond and cash allocations."
